status: declared by the pull request that closes #429 before any diagnostic was computed; reported only, nothing here changes the bar, the judge's declaration or any published figure; the choices below are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

false_alarms.source: docs/pivot/judge-amendment-result.md, Table 1 (the re-judge of #416 under the amended judge)

rows.rule: the five candidate rows with the most onsets flagged at lead >= 1; ties broken by the smaller worst false alarms per onset, then by name; the three reference rows (calendar_climatology, persistence_logistic, published_v1) are not candidates and are left out

false_alarms.flags: the judge's own: a probability at or above the flag cut-off chosen refit by refit from the training window (pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs), at +5 bp, at each horizon h = 1 to 5
false_alarms.false_alarm: a flag on a day that is not a pressure day (SOFR - IORB, on whole basis points, not strictly above +5 bp), on the days every horizon scores, as tier 1 counts them; the day split is the flagged (target) day, t + h

realised_spread_bp.reading: the spread of the flagged day on whole basis points (round(spread_bps))

distance_to_pressure_day.reading: panel days between the flagged day and the nearest pressure day (+5 bp), either side, read on the days to 2025-12-31 only; a flagged day within the last five panel days of the window may have a nearer pressure day after it that the window does not hold

false_alarms.day_type: the judge's day_type grouping (month_end, ordinary, quarter_end, tax_date), read as of the day; the regime grouping is reported beside it

power.statistic: the tier 1 recall conditions as the judge applies them at lead >= 1: the point recall is at least onset_recall_at_least (0.5) and the lower end of the bootstrap interval on recall is above the climatology recall at the same false alarms; the false-alarm limit is not simulated
power.model: each onset is flagged independently with the true recall; the climatology recall is a constant on every onset; non-onset days contribute nothing to the recall, so only the days' order and the onset positions matter
power.climatology_note: the lowest, a typical and the highest climatology recall of Table 1 of the re-judge
power.bootstrap: the judge's: stationary, 90% interval, block length and replications as in metadata/pressure_judge.json; a resample with no onset leaves the recall undefined, the interval is unavailable and the condition is not met (replicates are never dropped)

development_window.days: the days every horizon scores, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31, from the published panel
development_window.onsets: the 26 onsets the judge counts, at their positions in that window

confirmation_window.days_source: docs/decisions/lockbox.md, the table of tier starts: from 2026-01-01, 169 locked days, 5 of them above +5 bp
confirmation_window.onsets_note: a parameter, not a count: no day of the window is read. The lockbox record gives at most 5 pressure days in it, so at most 5 onsets
confirmation_window.placement: onsets evenly spaced over the window
